description_en: Queries scene rules in an edge instance by paging
description_zh: 分页查询边缘实例中的场景规则
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-edge-instance-scene-rule --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id llL44UVXUqb9m5000000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryEdgeInstanceSceneRule

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number from which to start displaying the results. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10
parameters.name: page_size
